watches.name: Atlas (World Labs)
watches.source_title: Atlas: A World Model for Spatial Intelligence
watches.summary: World Labs' next-generation omni world model, pretrained from scratch on text, images, video, and 3D. A multimodal autoregressive diffusion transformer with spatial context. Camera-controlled image/video generation (up to 1 minute at 1440p), spatial reconstruction from 1–dozens of images with explicit 3D (point clouds, 3D Gaussian splats), space-time simulation including video reframing and Real-to-Sim for robotics, plus text-to-image and 360 panoramas. Will power future versions of Marble and other World Labs products.
watches.pricing_note: Early access with select partners. Request access on the official blog. Not a public self-serve product; no published plan prices as of 2026-09-01.

watches.name: Lily (Perplexity)
watches.source_title: Optimizing On-Device Inference for Apple Silicon
watches.summary: Official Perplexity blog (checked 2026-09-02): Lily is a lightweight local inference engine built specifically for Apple silicon and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, with separate prefill and decode optimizations, so on-device compute does not bottleneck Hybrid Compute tasks in Perplexity Computer. A Rust runtime loads the checkpoint and runs the generation loop; an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API accepts requests; custom Metal kernels execute Qwen-specific operations. Neither PyTorch nor MLX is in the execution path. A standalone demo is on GitHub. The official pplx-garden README names that demo at github.com/perplexityai/pplx-garden (lily/): Apache-2.0 Metal inference server, greedy generation, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MLX affine 4-bit checkpoint format, Apple GPU family 10 or later (M5 and newer), macOS 26 or later. The garden README describes a minimal OpenAI-compatible HTTP API; the lily README as of this check documents POST /v1/chat/completions, GET /v1/models, and GET /health, and says streaming, sampling, tools, and multimodal requests are rejected. Vendor-published throughput figures were not independently reproduced.
watches.pricing_note: Open-source Apache-2.0 demo in perplexityai/pplx-garden (lily/). Not a Perplexity Pro/Max/Enterprise SKU. No public Lily plan price. Hardware, model weights, and any Perplexity Computer subscription are separate and were not priced on this check.
